description: reserve() does its read-modify-write inside the per-SKU lock, but release() reads and writes the same stock count outside the lock with an await between, so a concurrent reserve or release on the same SKU loses an update

hard.note: The lock is used correctly in reserve(), which makes the class look guarded; only release() skips it

_calibration.note: One lost-update race, bounded like cc-lost-update-map (1-3 issues, 1-2 errors)
